questions.question_english: The phenomenon where an individual’s private emotional or mental wellbeing is negatively impacted by comparing their real life with highlighted, curated online posts of peers is known as:
options_english: Algorithmic Drift Effect
Social Comparison
Bandwidth Fatigue Syndrome
Technological Determinism
questions.explanation_english: Social comparison theory in digital contexts describes the psychological process where individuals evaluate their personal worth, lifestyle, and appearance against highly curated, ideal images shared by peers online. Continuous exposure to sanitized highlights on social media triggers feelings of inadequacy, diminished self-esteem, envy, and anxiety. Fostering media literacy helps students recognize digital curation, reducing the negative emotional impacts of online social comparison.

questions.question_english: What is the main objective of using End-to-End Encryption (E2EE) in digital communication channels within educational institutions?
options_english: To enable comprehensive real-time administrative monitoring of all private student text messages across networks.
To allow only communicating users to read messages, preventing unauthorized interception.
To systematically extract and index private student conversations for automated plagiarism detection software.
To optimize network bandwidth and significantly accelerate data transmission rates across school local networks.
questions.explanation_english: End-to-end encryption ensures that cryptographic encryption occurs directly at the sender’s device and decryption occurs only at the recipient’s device. Intermediate network nodes, service providers, or potential eavesdroppers cannot access or decrypt the plain text contents of transmitted messages. In educational communication channels, this security architecture protects confidential exchanges, safeguards sensitive personal communications, and prevents unauthorized data interception or third-party surveillance across public and institutional networks.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। एंड-टू-एंड एन्क्रिप्शन यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि क्रिप्टोग्राफिक एन्क्रिप्शन सीधे प्रेषक के उपकरण पर होता है और डिक्रिप्शन केवल प्राप्तकर्ता के उपकरण पर होता है। मध्यवर्ती नेटवर्क नोड, सेवा प्रदाता, या संभावित ईव्सड्रॉपर्स प्रेषित संदेशों की स्पष्ट पाठ सामग्री तक पहुंच या उसे डिक्रिप्ट नहीं कर सकते। शैक्षणिक संचार चैनलों में, यह सुरक्षा आर्किटेक्चर गोपनीय आदान-प्रदान की रक्षा करता है, संवेदनशील व्यक्तिगत संचार को सुरक्षित करता है, और सार्वजनिक और संस्थागत नेटवर्क में अनधिकृत डेटा इंटरसेप्शन या तीसरे पक्ष की निगरानी को रोकता है।

questions.question_english: Regarding the erosion of critical thinking and analytical skills, which of the following is correct?
options_english: Primary definition and standard features of erosion of critical thinking and analytical skills
General principles
Operational criteria
Strategic guidelines
questions.explanation_english: The correct option is 'Operational criteria'. Exclusive reliance on generative artificial intelligence for analytical writing tasks severely undermines academic development. Outsourcing synthesis, critical evaluation, and original thought to automated models prevents students from developing essential problem-solving abilities, logical reasoning skills, and independent analytical capabilities. Over time, passive reliance on automated text generation hinders authentic cognitive engagement, impedes deep subject mastery, and compromises the core educational objective of fostering independent, reflective, and creative thinkers.

questions.explanation_english: Fact-checking methodologies enhance digital media literacy through structured evaluation strategies. questions.explanation_english: Typosquatting is a form of social engineering where attackers register domain names featuring common typographical errors of popular, legitimate websites.
